text:
Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of y.
Participated(x, y) ::: x participated in y.
TieGroupSize(y, n) ::: y is a tie group of size n.
FromCountry(x, y) ::: x is from y.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard of y.

Premises:
Winner(steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer was the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Participated(steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (TieGroupSize(x, 6) ∧ ∃y (FromCountry(y, Belgium) ∧ MemberOfTieGroup(y, x))) ::: There is a six-way tie, and one person from Belgium is in it.
FromCountry(descampe, Belgium) ::: Descampé is from Belgium.
MemberOfTieGroup(descampe, x) ::: Descampé is in the tie group x.
∀x (OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992) → Participated(x, duMaurier1992)) ::: All on the leaderboard participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.

Conclusion:
Descampé is in the six-way tie in the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
